mediaWork.title: Crossing the River Styx: The Memoir of a Death Row Chaplain
mediaWork.creatorName: Russ Ford, with Todd C. Peppers and Charles Peppers
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: A memoir recounting the experiences of Russ Ford as the head chaplain on Virginia's death row from 1984 to 2001, including his relationships with condemned prisoners and his observations of the prison system
mediaWork.summaryNotes: "Crossing the River Styx: The Memoir of a Death Row Chaplain" provides a unique perspective on the death penalty through the eyes of Russ Ford, who served as the head chaplain on Virginia's death row from 1984 to 2001.  The book details his experiences ministering to condemned prisoners, witnessing executions, and advocating for humane treatment. While not focused on wrongful convictions, it highlights the risk of executing innocent people and discusses systemic issues within the prison system, including inhumane treatment, insufficient medical care, botched executions, and the psychological toll on those involved.  The book also explores the spiritual journeys of the condemned.
